description: This file defines the ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter class which manages execution approval requests, handling incoming approval prompts, making decisions based on security policies, presenting user prompts, and resolving approval outcomes within an app's permission system.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for listening to approval request events, managing user prompts, and making security decisions regarding execution approvals.

classes.name: GatewayApprovalRequest
classes.description: A Codable data structure representing an approval request payload.

classes.name: PresentationDecision
classes.description: A structure encapsulating the decision parameters for presenting an approval prompt, including whether to ask, if presentation is possible, security policies, and allowlist.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the approval listening process by initiating a background task.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing approval request listening task.

methods.name: run
methods.description: An asynchronous function that subscribes to approval request streams and processes incoming events.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles individual approval push events, decoding payloads, making decisions, and responding with approval or denial.

methods.name: shouldPresent
methods.description: Determines if a prompt should be presented based on the request details and security policies.

methods.name: fallbackDecision
methods.description: Provides fallback decision logic when user prompting can't or shouldn't be performed.

methods.name: fallbackResolution
methods.description: Resolves command resolution details for fallback scenarios based on request properties.

methods.name: firstToken
methods.description: Extracts the first token (executable name) from a command string.

methods.name: shouldPresent
methods.description: Static helper to determine if a prompt should be shown based on session activity and connection mode.
